name: g2-i1current-c3-c4-classweight-diagnostic-v1
question: Same I1-current inputs/preprocessing/depth/seed; only class_weight differs (C3 None vs C4 balanced): how do rare-class over-prediction and major-class recall change? Diagnostic only — does not change the C4 selection.

reuse.C4: existing predictions.jsonl (variant base) for val/test/shift_zone/shift_ref; train/val C4 metrics from candidates.json
reuse.C3: trained once on full train with rf_i1current.py functions (features, Encoder, make_model) imported from the committed script; no edits

reproduction_check.C3: train and val acc, macro_f1_all_true and per-class P/R/F1/n/pred_n vs candidates.json C3 (stored rounded: acc/macro 4 dp, per-class 3 dp — compare at that precision)
reproduction_check.if_mismatch: report; retrain C4 once in the same environment, compare to existing C4 predictions, keep both; never overwrite

metrics.same_as: rf_i1current.py metrics(): acc, per-class P/R/F1/n/pred_n/runs, macro_f1_all_true (labels = classes with >=1 true scene), macro_f1_baseline_set (labels = baseline A lookup primary_classes of that eval set), confusion, per_run acc + unweighted mean
metrics.labels_recorded: every macro F1 stores its label list; prediction-only classes listed separately

paired.per_scene: both_correct / c3_only / c4_only / both_wrong / changed (C3 pred != C4 pred)
paired.rare_definition: rule with train support <= 5 (full train, 730 scenes) — fixed before evaluation
paired.rare_over_prediction: pred_n vs true n per rare class per eval set
paired.per_run: changed scenes and acc C3/C4 per run

interpretation_limits: C4 stays the pre-registered val-selected model; C3 is not promoted
test/shift were seen several times; not a blind test
not game performance / decision quality / execution
does not decide whether I2 is needed

env_expected.venv: /tmp/rfexp/venv (same venv as the I1-current run; pip freeze identical to requirements-freeze.txt)
